options.name: content
options.description: Card content. Strings render as text (non-empty); Nodes are inserted as given. Inserted at construction and again only when update() passes content.

options.name: describe
options.description: The trigger references the card with aria-describedby (added to existing ids). Set false for long or highly interactive cards.

options.name: placement
options.description: Preferred side and logical alignment; flips and shifts to fit.

options.name: showDelay
options.description: Delay before showing on hover or keyboard focus, ms. 0 shows synchronously.

options.name: hideDelay
options.description: Grace period after the pointer leaves trigger and card before hiding, ms. Always asynchronous, so the pointer can move onto the card.

properties.name: element
properties.description: The card (div.aui-hover-card, popover=manual), inserted right after the trigger.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Show immediately, clearing an Escape dismissal; hides any other visible hover card.

methods.name: hide
methods.description: Hide immediately (reason 'programmatic'); focus inside the card moves to the trigger.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merge and apply options; content is replaced only when passed; repositions when open. A failed update keeps the previous options.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Hide; remove the card, the trigger aria-describedby reference, listeners, and subscriptions.

events.name: aui-open
events.description: After the card became visible (dispatched on the card element).

events.name: aui-close
events.description: After the card was hidden. 'programmatic' covers hide(), destroy(), and another hover card showing.

contentAreas.name: content
contentAreas.description: The card element's children (the content option). Framework-owned nodes appended to element survive updates that do not pass content.

cssClasses.name: aui-hover-card
cssClasses.description: Card element (manual popover, top layer); data-placement holds the final placement.

cssClasses.name: aui-hover-card--static
cssClasses.description: Set on show when animation is disabled globally or by reduced motion.
